name: Jalithai Winters
source:
Jalithai Winters is the polished face of the Society of Ravens, a politician who can move between council chambers and glittering galas without missing a beat. Born into wealth and privilege, she has never known a day without comfort, and she wears it like armor. She dresses sharp, speaks smoother than most, and always knows which way the political winds are blowing, often because she is the one turning them. Her rise from well-connected socialite to power broker was paved with favors, debts, and a careful balance of loyalty to the Society and service to the city's elite.

[From the in-game profile]
